profile_text.body:
CACI International Inc. is a public company traded on the NYSE under the ticker CACI, with its website at caci.com. Its own site describes it as a national security and technology contractor, using the phrase "Ever Vigilant" for its posture toward emerging threats. The company says it works on electronic warfare, counter-UAS, deep learning, and agile DevSecOps, and it points to more than 20 years of experience in RF-based solutions, describing its modular, scalable, software-defined technology as battle-proven, rapidly deployable, and interoperable with existing C-UxS systems for layered defense.

Other areas the site covers include end-to-end IT modernization from on-premises to cloud and edge, application and business process modernization for government customers using Agile methods and advanced analytics, and American-made optical communication, sensing, and processing technology for missions it characterizes as spanning the battlefield to deep space. CACI also announced the opening of a Manufacturing Center of Excellence for Defense Electronics in the Greater Rochester, New York, area, an award with a one-year base plus four option periods to support U.S. Central Command and its mission partners, and selection to deliver technology for the U.S. Space Force. It separately announced the launch of Good Dogs for Great Americans, which it calls its signature philanthropy program.

The site's material is largely capability and contract announcements rather than product detail, and it does not name specific AI products. No litigation, no tracked products, and no MCP servers are recorded for the company. Its registration record lists CIK 0000016058 and confirms its status as a for-profit public company.
